dct_description_sm: Ta'an Kwäch'än Council (TKC) is a Self-Governed First Nation who have lived and cared for the lands in and around both Whitehorse and the Lake Laberge (Tàa'an Män) area in the Yukon since time immemorial. Ta'an Kwäch'än lands were shared with their neighbours, the Tagish Kwän, Big Salmon people, with whom they had family connections as well. The community has given TKC’s Lands & Resources department the direction to undertake research of these creeks and rivers, collecting information about water quality and quantity with the goal to determine current conditions, identify potential contaminants and to monitor long-term trends that may impact the habitat of fish and wildlife. In the short term we provide results on water conditions that are important to the community about when and where conservation is appropriate.
dct_title_s: Ta'an Kwäch'än Council - Yukon River Watershed Sampling Program
